construction_role.detail: Self-performs utility construction, maintenance and storm restoration, with pre-construction engineering and design support.

notes: Public funding is inferred from customers being regulated utilities, which are mostly private or investor-owned.

project_type.detail: Electric transmission and distribution, gas pipelines, battery storage, renewable gas, plus fiber and water networks.

public_funding.detail: Customers are mainly regulated utilities and energy providers, funded through ratepayers rather than public budgets.

sub_sector.value: electric and natural gas utility infrastructure construction services; storm restoration
